notes: Conditional linear-sample tradeoff. For m=2n the source rounds the time exponent to 0.43ωn; for m≥6.6n it reports approximately 0.344n time and 0.289n memory. Rounded decimals are not ingested as exact coefficients.

extra.parameters: Odd prime q=q(n), polynomially bounded; n variables; m=Cn with fixed C>1; β=C−1/2−√(C(C−1)); 2≤ω<3.
extra.secret: Arbitrary s∈Z_q^n; this is binary ERROR, not an assumption of binary secret.
extra.samples: Exactly m=Cn; changing C changes the exponent.
extra.objective: Recover s by solving the error-free quadratic system.
extra.model: Arithmetic in Z_q; H₂(x)=−xlog₂x−(1−x)log₂(1−x). Formula follows Theorem 7 plus Proposition 1’s binomial coefficient.
extra.assumptions: Assumption 2: the specific quadratic equations are semi-regular.
extra.success: Conditional on Assumption 2 and the intended unique-solution regime.

evidence.locator: §6, Theorem 7(ii)–(iii), Eqs. (10)–(11), pp. 12–13; proof Eq. (14) and Proposition 1
